lines: Without a licence a package may not be distributed at all; ask its maintainers for one, or replace it.
1 shipped package is under "CC-BY-3.0", a licence licences.json gives no verdict on:
Read the licence itself to decide whether it can ship with the app.

The 1,025 shipped packages by licence: MIT 865, ISC 84, BSD-2-Clause 21, BSD-3-Clause 20, GPL-3.0-or-later 11, Apache-2.0 9, (MIT OR CC0-1.0) 4, (BSD-2-Clause OR MIT OR Apache-2.0) 1, and 10 licences more.
The app is under AGPL-3.0-or-later, as appinfo/info.xml declares; licences.json held each licence against it.
The advisories were not checked (NO_ADVISORIES=1 or --no-advisories): this report says nothing about vulnerable packages.
